edges: P. D. James commented on Agatha Christie's writing style regarding the guilty party in her stories.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Agatha Christie wrote her books up to the last chapter and then decided on the unlikely suspect.
Brian Aldiss claimed that Agatha Christie told him about her writing process.
Agatha Christie wrote her books up to the last chapter and then decided on the most unlikely suspect.
